menu: AEONS main menu key art: a single sweeping landscape where the ages of civilisation flow into one another from left to right — Bronze Age ziggurat and river fields at golden dawn, marble temples and a harbour colossus, a medieval castle and cathedral on a hill, a Renaissance dome, smoking industrial towers, and a gleaming modern skyline with a rocket rising — all joined by one winding luminous river that catches the light, a lone cloaked figure with a banner standing on a cliff in the foreground gazing across the ages, vast dramatic sky shifting from dawn gold to twilight blue with the first stars.
victory: Victory key art: a triumphant golden apotheosis over a radiant fictional capital city — a laurel-crowned monument and great wonder bathed in blazing golden light, crowds and raised banners on the grand steps below, fireworks and god rays bursting through parting clouds, golden petals and embers drifting upward, feeling of an eternal legacy earned.
defeat: Defeat key art: the fall of a great fictional empire at twilight — a shattered colossal statue of a crowned ruler half-buried in ash before a burning ruined capital, broken columns and toppled banners, smoke columns rising into a bruised crimson and violet sky, a few survivors trudging away in silhouette, a single ember of hope glowing in the foreground ruins.
